neighbours.label: the slot that sets up a right/wrong verdict ('I was [right]', 'prove him [wrong]')
fire: I bet the cake would collapse in the oven, and sadly I was right.
Everyone doubted her, so she worked hard to prove them wrong.
I assumed the store would be closed, but I was wrong.
The experiment proved the old professor right after all.
Turns out my mother was right about that apartment.
He thought the bridge would hold, and he was dead wrong.
Time will tell whether the critics were right.
Was Darwin right about the origin of these finches?
quiet: I baked a cake for the party, and sadly it collapsed in the oven.
Everyone doubted her, so she worked hard every single day.
I assumed the store would be closed, so I stayed home.
The experiment took the old professor three years to finish.
Turns out my mother lived in that apartment for years.
He thought the bridge was beautiful, especially at night.
Time will tell whether the critics enjoy the new film.
Did Darwin travel to the islands with these finches?
